task: Perform live screen-reader speech acceptance for the Sensei Sandy website using Orca with headed Chrome. Verify shared navigation and menu narration, Schedule date controls, and Free Intro form labels and required-field errors. Record actual Orca speech logs and browser state. Do not submit the form or activate booking, SMS, email, or availability actions.

definition_of_done.criterion: Live Orca speech is captured for shared navigation and mobile menu open, expanded state, close, and focus return; actual words and state are recorded.
Live Orca speech is captured for keyboard focus on a schedule date and keyboard selection of another date; announced date and class details are recorded.
Live Orca speech is captured for Free Intro field labels and required-field invalid state; no real submission occurs.

constraints: Use production route state as current evidence and preserve prior local preview results as historical context only.
Never submit the Free Intro form or activate booking, SMS, email, availability, or other external actions.
Do not alter public copy, schedule facts, or deploy site code unless a reproduced defect and authoritative fix are established.
Use one headed Chrome and Orca session at a time because the local display and speech service are shared.
Record the browser, Orca version, route, input method, spoken text, and browser state; do not claim physical speech was independently heard unless it was.

workstreams.task: Audit production shared navigation and mobile-menu screen-reader speech using Orca and keyboard navigation.
workstreams.deliverable: Exact Orca speech excerpts and state observations for skip link, navigation landmarks/links, menu open, expanded state, Escape, and focus return.
workstreams.contribution: Establish whether navigation labels and menu state changes are actually announced to Orca.
allowed_tools: Playwright CDP for keyboard input and state capture
verification: Use a fresh production page and log Orca output during actual keyboard interaction.
Check expanded/collapsed state in the accessibility tree and compare it with Orca speech.
Do not activate any external link.

workstreams.task: Audit production Schedule date navigation and selected-date speech using Orca and keyboard controls.
workstreams.deliverable: Exact Orca speech excerpts for a focused date control, a keyboard-selected date, and its class details.
workstreams.contribution: Determine whether date focus, selection changes, and related class details are spoken clearly and in order.
allowed_tools: Playwright CDP for keyboard input and state capture
verification: Navigate dates using keyboard only and capture Orca output.
Compare spoken date and class details with the rendered selected-day state.
Do not activate booking or external contact links.

workstreams.task: Audit production Free Intro form labels and required-field error speech using Orca without submitting the form.
workstreams.deliverable: Exact Orca speech excerpts for field labels, required status, and the browser validation error; accessibility associations are recorded.
workstreams.contribution: Determine whether the form's required-field guidance is spoken when focus moves to an invalid field.
allowed_tools: Playwright CDP for keyboard input and state capture
verification: Use only a fresh blank form and inspect one required field.
Use native validity reporting without form submission and capture Orca speech.
Verify label and error associations in the DOM/accessibility tree.
